description: This file defines a PHP class Zend_XmlRpc_Response_Http that extends Zend_XmlRpc_Response. It overrides the __toString() method to send an HTTP Content-Type header before returning the string representation of the response. The class is part of the Zend Framework's XML-RPC handling, specifically for HTTP responses.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Response_Http
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_XmlRpc_Response to send HTTP headers for XML-RPC responses over HTTP.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Overrides the parent __toString() method to send an HTTP Content-Type header before returning the string response.
